broad: misfolded or incompletely synthesized glycoprotein catabolic process

definition: An ERAD pathway whereby endoplasmic reticulum (ER)-resident glycoproteins are targeted for degradation. Includes differential processing of the glycoprotein sugar chains, retrotranslocation to the cytosol and degradation by the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway. A glycoprotein is a compound in which a carbohydrate component is covalently bound to a protein component.
label: ubiquitin-dependent glycoprotein ERAD pathway
